patterns.note: Asymmetrical two-column layouts are used for product descriptions, pairing large, abstract imagery with concise text blocks.
A highly distinctive, organic, rounded display serif font is used exclusively for the brand name, contrasting with clean, functional sans-serifs for all other text.
A vibrant, warm orange and deep reddish-purple are used as primary brand accents and for key text, set against a soft, muted cream background, with a cool blue for the footer and sticky elements.
A 'Sign up for updates' call-to-action box appears on scroll and remains sticky in the bottom-right corner of the viewport, providing a persistent engagement point.
Sections are clearly delineated by alternating background colors (cream, light grey, and blue), creating distinct visual blocks for different content types.

technique_notes: The hero section features an oversized, organic display typeface for the brand name, which appears to be rendered as a canvas element or SVG for scalable, custom typography.
Product and descriptive sections integrate large, abstract, textural images that evoke a sensory experience, often placed in an asymmetrical layout next to text content.

A persistent call-to-action for newsletter signup is implemented as a sticky element that reveals after initial scroll and remains fixed in the bottom right of the viewport, likely using JavaScript for scroll detection and CSS for positioning.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, organic display font for the hero (~8x body) with bold, condensed sans-serif headings (~2x body) and clean, legible sans-serif body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on interactive elements like buttons and input fields, while images maintain sharp corners.
design_tokens.spacing: Generally airy with generous vertical padding between sections and within content blocks, creating a spacious and unhurried feel.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its bold, organic, almost hand-drawn typography for the brand name, which immediately conveys a playful and natural brand identity. This is uniquely complemented by abstract, textural imagery that evokes a strong sensory experience, making the product feel artisanal and high-quality.
